critical_code_review_comments: CareRelief.js CALMING list [head, neck, chest, abdomen, lower_back, upper_back, pelvis, buttocks, general] correctly excludes limb keys (upper_arm, forearm, hand, shoulder, thigh, knee, shin_calf, foot) — verified via live run.

Onboarding.js uses an inner Inp component defined inside the parent function body (line 45). React will recreate this component on each render; while it works today, a user typing fast could lose focus between keystrokes. Consider moving Inp outside the component or using useCallback/memoization. Not currently causing visible issues in tests.
Statistics appears twice in the DOM when logged in (desktop nav + user menu). Expected because of responsive menus — note for selector authors to use .first() if asserting single instance.
